params.text: 1. Keep the orange zone clear: min. 600 in front (rows, dips, push-ups), min. 500 each side.\P2. Ceiling: bar height + approx. 300 head clearance, so approx. 2500 at the top setting.\P3. Max. load 150 kg. Tower weight 20 kg. No anchor holes: flat, level floor; check bolts weekly.\P4. Arm pads tilt 10° inward. Backrest height is fixed; its depth has 5 positions.\P5. Bar: 9 heights from 1450 to 2200, approx. 94 apart. Rear crossbar at about knee height: bend your knees behind you on pull-ups.\P6. approx. = estimated from product photos, not maker data. Check your own tower.
